items.en: V4.1 now has owner-accepted Driver, Personality/Design, Semantic Tag, compositional and Runtime Owner rules. A personal Question / Capability orientation is published only when this case has an admitted Gate + Line + Driver + Layer composition with explicit tag evidence. The calculated baseline remains available; without that case-specific binding, orientation remains unknown.
items.zh: V4.1 现已具备经过 Owner ACCEPT 的 Driver、Personality／Design、Semantic Tag、组合规则与 Runtime Owner 规则。只有当本案例存在已获准的 Gate + Line + Driver + Layer 组合，并具有明确 tag evidence 时，才发布个人化的问题／能力方向。已计算的基线结构仍保留；若缺少该个案绑定，方向继续保持未知。

items.en: Figures 4A–4B define the Carrier architecture and the R7 owner rules now govern how semantic composition may become K2A / Carrier evidence. Personal hierarchy, capacity, constraint, integrity, connectivity or recovery-baseline values are published only when the case supplies admitted composition and evidence; otherwise the architecture is known while the personal result remains unknown.
items.zh: Figure 4A–4B 已定义载体架构，R7 Runtime Owner 规则也已规定组合语义何时可以进入 K2A／Carrier。个人化的层级、容量、约束、完整性、连接或恢复基线，只有在本案例具备已获准的组合与证据时才发布；否则架构已知，但个人结果继续保持未知。

items.en: Figure 4C defines the C1 Carrier Runtime fields, and R7 now provides governed semantic and owner rules for resolving them. Personal intake, environment, perception, cognition, biology, regulation, connectivity, cost or Carrier Runtime Style is shown only when an admitted case-specific composition resolves to C1 with sufficient evidence; otherwise those values remain unknown.
items.zh: Figure 4C 已定义 C1 载体运行字段，R7 也已建立受治理的语义与 owner 规则。个人化摄取、环境、感知、认知、生物运行、调节、连接、运行成本或载体运行方式，只有当已获准的个案组合在充分证据下解析至 C1 时才显示；否则这些数值继续保持未知。

items.en: Figure 5A defines the C2 Experience engine. R7 may route an admitted composition to C2 when the semantic object is explicitly about experience, attention, valuation, selection or perspective. Without sufficient case-specific evidence for that ownership, experience filter, stability, perspective, motivation, emotional weighting and meaning orientation remain unknown.
items.zh: Figure 5A 已定义 C2 体验引擎。只有当已获准组合明确描述体验、注意、价值权重、选择或视角，并具备充分个案证据时，R7 才可把语义对象归属 C2。若不足以支持该 owner，体验过滤、稳定模式、视角、动机、情绪权重与意义方向继续保持未知。

items.en: Figure 5B defines the C3 Expression engine. R7 may route an admitted composition to C3 only when translation, compression, externalization, medium or expression threshold is explicitly supported. Without that case-specific evidence, expression drive, translation, compression, architecture, threshold, medium and expression style remain unknown.
items.zh: Figure 5B 已定义 C3 表达引擎。只有当个案证据明确支持翻译、压缩、外化、媒介或表达阈值时，R7 才可把已获准组合归属 C3。若缺少这些个案证据，表达驱动力、转换方式、压缩、表达架构、阈值、媒介与表达风格继续保持未知。

items.en: Figure 5C defines the C4 Agency engine. R7 may route an admitted composition to C4 when the semantic object concerns direction, evaluation, exclusion, commitment, resource allocation, choice or execution readiness. Without sufficient case-specific evidence, direction, decision strategy, choice, conflict, responsibility, commitment and execution readiness remain unknown.
items.zh: Figure 5C 已定义 C4 行动引擎。当已获准组合的语义对象明确涉及方向、评估、排除、承诺、资源配置、选择或执行准备时，R7 才可归属 C4。若个案证据不足，方向、决策策略、选择、冲突、责任、承诺与执行准备度继续保持未知。

items.en: Figure 5D defines the C5 Identity engine. R7 may route an admitted composition to C5 only when identity stabilization, self-model or role continuity, identity boundary, drift or identity reconfiguration is explicitly supported. Personality layer alone never assigns C5, and no fixed identity type is inferred; unsupported personal identity values remain unknown.
items.zh: Figure 5D 已定义 C5 身份引擎。只有当个案证据明确支持身份稳定、自我模型或角色连续、身份边界、身份漂移或身份重组时，R7 才可把已获准组合归属 C5。Personality layer 本身绝不能直接指定 C5，也不会推断固定身份类型；未获证据支持的个人身份数值继续保持未知。

items.en: No Current Reality observations are bound to this review case. V4.1 supports observation and comparison only; semantic architecture or Runtime Owner assignment does not by itself establish a current driver priority, bottleneck, overload, drift, recovery, runtime state or action conclusion. Those remain unknown without separately admitted current evidence.
items.zh: 此审核案例尚未绑定任何当前现实观察。V4.1 在这里仅支持观察与对照；语义架构或 Runtime Owner 归属本身不能建立当前驱动优先级、瓶颈、过载、漂移、恢复、运行状态或行动结论。若没有另行获准的 current evidence，这些内容全部保持未知。

items.en: Astronomical coordinates are calculated outputs. Gate and Line sources, Driver and Personality/Design roles, Semantic Tags, composition rules and Runtime Owner rules are governed interpretation authorities; they are not evidence of biological causation or guaranteed outcomes. Personal C1–C5 or Current Reality values require admitted case-specific evidence. Unresolved fields remain unknown, with the complete unknown record retained in the technical evidence appendix.
items.zh: 天文坐标属于计算输出。Gate 与 Line 来源、Driver 与 Personality／Design roles、Semantic Tags、组合规则及 Runtime Owner 规则属于受治理的解释 authority，并不是生物因果证明，也不是必然结果。个人化 C1–C5 或 Current Reality 数值仍需要已获准的个案证据。未解决字段继续保持未知，完整 unknown 记录保留在技术证据附录。

items.title: BREAKTHROUGH / 突破
items.reviewNote: Breakthrough is anchored first in reorganization / continuity; Identity and Agency remain secondary or overlay contexts.

items.title: OVERLOAD / 过载
items.reviewNote: Overload remains capacity/cost tension; it does not directly assert agency collapse or runtime failure.

items.title: STALL / 迟滞
items.reviewNote: Stall is governed as constraint / incomplete-condition tension, without automatic drift or collapse claims.

items.title: LOOP / 反复
items.reviewNote: Loop stays feedback/experience repetition; Identity is not inferred without separate identity evidence.

items.title: WITHDRAWAL / 封闭
items.reviewNote: Withdrawal is protective contraction / reduced input-connectivity; it is not converted into identity dissolution semantics.

item.candidateRule: Physical body binding remains structural evidence only. D may affect personal topic selection only when the specific Birth/Design activation resolves through admitted Gate Base + Line Modifier + Driver Role + Personality/Design Layer composition and produces admitted semantic tags and/or a separately governed salience rule. Body presence alone cannot select a topic. D11 Earth is deterministically derived from the corresponding Sun longitude + 180° and follows the same rule; there is no Chiron exception in V4.1.
item.candidateRuleZh: Physical body binding 继续只作为结构证据。只有当具体 Birth／Design activation 经过已获准的 Gate Base + Line Modifier + Driver Role + Personality／Design Layer 组合，并产生已获准的 semantic tags，和／或满足另行治理的 salience rule 时，D 才能影响个人 topic selection。仅仅因为某个天体存在，不能选择 topic。D11 Earth 由对应 Sun longitude + 180° 确定性推导，并遵循同一规则；V4.1 不再存在 Chiron 例外。
boundaries: Equal salience or insufficient evidence -> UNKNOWN
D11 = EARTH; former Chiron rule is deleted
